query:
WITH inserted AS (
                INSERT INTO rb_team_puzzle (team_id, puzzle_id, state)
                SELECT $1, UNNEST($2::int[]), 0
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
                RETURNING puzzle_id
            )
            SELECT p.id, p.title, p.round_id
            FROM inserted i
            JOIN rb_puzzle p ON p.id = i.puzzle_id;
